title: Cervical Spine MRI Showing Nerve/Canal Impingement
author: Nevit Dilmen (talk)
caption: Sagittal T2-weighted MRI of the cervical spine demonstrating intervertebral disc protrusion and spinal canal narrowing.
alt_text: Sagittal MRI scan of the cervical spine showing disc impingement.
clinical_relevance: Illustrates neuroimaging used to diagnose structural spinal cord or nerve root impingement in worst-case radiculopathy/myelopathy (CLIFF-058, p.5-6).
